thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — Sev P2 — increased 5xx rate detected for inference-service (us-west-2). Rolling window 5m: error rate 18% -> paging oncall-eng

oncall-eng: Ack. On it. Pulling logs now, switching to #eng-oncall for triage.

maria: Adding context — customer telemetry shows latency spikes starting ~11:01 UTC and timeouts at 11:03. Affects batch and single-shot endpoints.

oncall-eng: Quick status: can reproduce locally against prod replica; single requests occasionally hit a downstream timeout to kv-cache. Starting scoped mitigation: increase kv-client timeout from 200ms -> 500ms for route /v1/generate.

luis: FYI I see a burst of failed keepalives from worker-73 around 11:02:14. Dumping kernel logs now.

oncall-eng: Pushing scoped config change (no rollout, single-host) so we can test behavior before cluster-wide. Command: ```rctl config set inference.kv.timeout_ms 500 --host worker-73```

oncall-eng: Patch applied to worker-73. Observing metrics...

incident-bot: deploy-bot started patch: rctl-config-1812345678 by oncall-eng.

maria: Customer impact note: a few beta customers reported truncated responses. Surface area appears limited to requests with long prefix tokens + cache miss.

oncall-eng: After host patch, worker-73 5xx rate dropped from 23% -> 4% over 2 minutes. Good signal. Need to confirm if config change is safe cluster-wide.

tim: Hypothesis A: recent kv-client sync change (PR #1412) reduced resilience to transient socket resets and shortened backoff. Hypothesis B: kernel OOM/eviction causing worker restart loops on a subset.

luis: Uploading logs snippet for worker-73 (11:01:55-11:04:10):
```
[11:02:14] WARN kv_client: connection reset by peer
[11:02:14] ERROR request_handler: timeout waiting for kv response (200ms)
[11:02:15] INFO runtime: gc pause 40ms
[11:02:18] ERROR http: write tcp 10.1.2.73:443: connection reset by peer
[11:03:01] INFO worker: recycle idle sessions
```

oncall-eng: Thanks. I'm going to run a controlled revert-test of PR #1412 on a small canary (worker-74) and compare error rates. Revert command: ```git revert --no-edit 3f2a8b2 && rdeploy inference-service --hosts worker-74 --tag canary-revert```

deploy-bot: deploy started: inference-service canary-revert to worker-74 by oncall-eng (build 2026.3.14-rc).

eva: If revert reduces 5xx quickly, we should consider either immediate rollback or a mitigation that reverts only the kv-client sync change. Also check for increased latency on other paths.

sre-rotation: I'm pairing with oncall for handoff in 40m. If we need extended mitigation, I'll take over.

oncall-eng: Canary revert is up. Early signal: worker-74 error rate fell from 21% -> 2% within 90s. This strongly supports Hypothesis A (PR #1412 regression).

maria: Noting customer-facing impact for incident report: partial service degradation for ~12 minutes for subset of requests. No data exfiltration.

tim: Next steps proposal: 1) roll back PR #1412 cluster-wide, 2) run post-rollback load test, 3) open follow-up to harden kv-client backoff and add unit tests. Owners: rollback = oncall-eng, verification = tim + luis, postmortem doc = maria.

luis: Agree. I'll prepare a revert patch to apply to the Dedicated pool (us-west-2) and a scoped autoscaling ramp to avoid flapping.

oncall-eng: Initiating cluster rollback: ```rdeploy inference-service --tag revert-3f2a8b2 --hosts us-west-2 --batch 5``` Monitoring logs and SPAN traces for correlation id X-Trace.

deploy-bot: rollout started: revert-3f2a8b2 to us-west-2 by oncall-eng. Batch size 5 hosts.

oncall-eng: Rolling metrics update: cluster 5xx trending down: 14% -> 3% across region in 6 minutes.

eva: For RCA thread: please paste timeline + test artifacts into the postmortem doc 'incidents/2026-11-14-inference-kv-regression' and leave raw logs in the incident bucket. I'll coordinate customer comms once rollback stabilizes.

maria: I've created the postmortem stub and added owner assignments. Link: https://company.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3141

sre-rotation: Handoff: I'm taking over monitoring and follow-ups. oncall-eng — leave any running debug commands and local dumps in /tmp/incident-1812345678. I'll escalate if we see re-emergence.

oncall-eng: Handoff acknowledged. Final note: primary hypothesis confirmed by canary revert -> cluster rollback. Root cause: PR #1412 changed kv-client sync/backoff behavior; it made short transient resets turn into immediate request failures. Action items: rollback, add retry/backoff tests, increase default kv timeout slightly, and add alert for single-host keepalive spikes.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Please update severity and close if stable for 1h.

maria: Closing loop with Product/Support: draft customer note ready for review.

sre-rotation: I'll update last_message_ts when we declare stable.

oncall-eng: Leaving final logs and trace IDs: traces: [X-Trace-111, X-Trace-112]. local dump: /tmp/incident-1812345678/dump.tar.gz
